description: Updater for Total Commander plugins - looks for new versions on totalcmd.net, ghisler.com and GitHub and installs them.
pre_install: if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir\TCplup.json")) { Set-Content "$dir\TCplup.json" '{}' -Encoding ASCII }; if (!(Test-Path "$persist_dir\TCplup.ini")) { Set-Content "$dir\TCplup.ini" '[Settings]' -Encoding ASCII }
